title: User Management
description: Invite team members, pre-create accounts, assign workspace roles, deactivate departures.
forbiddenBody: Only agency admins can manage users.
addAria: Add a user: send an invitation or pre-create an account

sendInvite.emailHint: We'll send a one-time link to set their password.
sendInvite.agencyAdminHint: Agency admins can manage members, workspaces, and all agency settings. Only grant to people you trust with full access.
sendInvite.workspacesHint: Pick at least one role in at least one workspace. Leaving everything blank adds the person to the agency but gives them no workspace access — they can sign in but cannot open any workspace.
sendInvite.noWorkspaces: Create a workspace first, then invite people into it.

addDirectly.emailHint: We'll pre-create the account and email a setup link.

addDirectlyShareCreds: Share these credentials securely — they won't be shown again.
addDirectlyPasswordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit. Share this with the new user out-of-band — it won't be shown again after the form is reset.
addDirectlyForceChange: Force password change on first login
addDirectlyForceChangeHint: The user will be sent to a set-password screen the first time they sign in. Recommended — keeps admin-supplied passwords from being a permanent backdoor.

library.title: Planning library
library.description: Reusable campaigns, content pillars, and templates for this workspace.
library.campaignsEmptyDescription: Create one from the planning list to bundle related ideas.
library.pillarsEmptyDescription: Pillars group your ideas into recurring themes for the workspace.
library.templatesEmptyDescription: Templates speed up drafting — save a proven format and reuse it for future ideas.

manual.label: Manual
manual.description: Channel has no provider connection. Manually managed.

connected.label: Connected
connected.description: Provider active. Daily metrics are being collected.

needs_reauth.label: Needs reconnect
needs_reauth.description: Three consecutive auth/permission failures. Reconnect to resume.

sync_error.label: Sync delayed
sync_error.description: Transient provider error. The cron will retry.

disconnected.label: Disconnected
disconnected.description: Provider connection removed. Historical metrics are preserved.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Keep the brand's account information in one place. Connections and analytics are planned for a future version.
channels.adminEmpty: A workspace manager can add the brand's accounts here.
channels.memberEmpty: Once a workspace manager adds accounts, they will appear in this list.
channels.connectMetaDescription: Authorize Facebook Pages and any linked Instagram professional accounts. Read-only — no publishing, no ads.
channels.setupMetaDescription: An agency admin needs to add Meta app credentials before the workspace can connect a Meta account. The setup is per-agency and takes one minute.
channels.metaErrorAccessDenied: Meta authorization was cancelled. Click Connect Meta to try again.
channels.metaErrorNotConfigured: This agency has no Meta provider configured. An admin must add Meta app credentials first.
channels.metaErrorMissingCode: Meta returned without an authorization code. Try again.
channels.metaErrorProviderError: The Meta authorization exchange failed. Check the app credentials and try again.
channels.metaErrorExchangeFailed: The Meta authorization exchange failed. Try again.
channels.metaErrorInvalidState: The OAuth state token was missing or already used. Try again.

channelsAdd.title: Add social channel
channelsAdd.description: Track the brand's accounts in one place. New ideas target all active channels by default; you can change channels per idea.

channelsEdit.title: Edit social channel
channelsEdit.description: Update how this account appears across the planner. Changes apply to new ideas immediately.
channelsEdit.activeHint: Inactive channels are hidden from new idea targeting.
channelsEdit.archiveConfirmBody: This hides the channel from new ideas but preserves its audit history. You can re-activate it from the database if needed.

retest.auth_expired: Your Meta access has expired. Reconnect to resume.
retest.permission_denied: The connected account is missing the analytics permission. Reconnect and grant access.
retest.rate_limited: Meta is rate-limiting this account. The next scheduled sync will retry.
retest.provider_unavailable: Meta is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
retest.not_found: The connected account could not be found. It may have been deleted or renamed.
retest.invalid_response: Meta returned an unrecognized response. The endpoint may be temporarily unavailable; try again in a few minutes.
retest.platform_kek_missing: Platform credential envelope is not configured. Contact your agency admin.
retest.social_not_enabled: Social sync is not enabled for this agency. Contact your agency admin.
retest.not_configured: This channel's analytics are not configured. Ask your agency admin to check the app credentials in Agency Settings, or ask Meta to enable the missing insights metric for the app.
retest.no_connection: This channel is not currently linked to a provider grant.
retest.not_connected: This channel is not in a connected state. Reconnect to resume.
retest.unknown: The validation request failed. Try again, or check the system status.

channelsConnectionActions.revokeDialogBody: This will revoke the shared Meta grant and disconnect every account attached to it. Historical metrics are preserved.

invitationList.noAccessTitle: On accept this person will be added to the agency but cannot access any workspace until you grant a role.

memberEdit.title: Edit {name}
memberEdit.description: Adjust agency-wide access and per-workspace roles. Each workspace can hold any number of roles — pick the ones that match what this person actually does.
memberEdit.adminHelp: Submitting this section flips the flag. The role form below is unaffected.
memberEdit.workspaceRolesHelp: Each role grants a specific capability in that workspace. Hold a role with responsibility for any of the workflow steps it controls.
memberEdit.noWorkspacesInAgency: No workspaces in this agency yet.

voiceSuggestions.pickHint: Pick a suggestion to fill the form, then edit.
voiceSuggestions.empty: The model did not return any suggestions. Try again or write one yourself.
